Frequently asked questions

Admissions information

Where is Princeway College located?

The school is now in Korathota, Athurugiriya, Sri Lanka. Please contact us before your first visit for the most direct route and current office hours.

What is the teaching medium?

The day school provides English-medium education. Extra-class support may be available in English and Sinhala medium.

Which curriculum does the school follow?

Kindergarten and primary education is shaped around Sri Lanka’s national curriculum. Princeway College also offers private tuition support for learners following the Cambridge curriculum.

How do I ask about fees and availability?

Call +94 71 475 4848 or email info@princewaycollege.com. The school will provide current information rather than outdated published details.
